notes: Synthetic vertical corpus v1 (LAB-005): 36 tasks across search / retrieval / scrape, tiered by difficulty. All entities and URLs are fictional; no user or customer data. Tier semantics: easy = single unambiguous query, medium = requires query refinement or multi-hop filtering, hard = ambiguous intent, conflicting sources, or multi-step composition.
